source_role: Official British Museum catalogue metadata snapshot; not an image reference.
description: Bronze ewer with a flat base decorated with incised concentrics and three low feet, a bulbous body, an everted rim and a decorated handle with a lotiform terminal.
acquisition: Purchased in 1902 through Rev Chauncey Murch from Mohammed Mohassib.
